Hi Maria —

Thanks again for the conversation this morning. As discussed, I put together a lightweight 30/60/90 close trajectory and a compact MAP for the initial evaluation window. What I shared:
- Compact MAP (one-pager with milestone owners) — Google Doc link below
- Suggested close trajectory (30/60/90) with gating criteria and owner assignments
- A short spreadsheet with dependencies and procurement items attached

Ask: please take a quick pass on the doc and confirm the core stakeholders (technical, procurement, legal). If the timeline looks reasonable, can we lock in a pilot start target week of Oct 19 and a contract decision window by Nov 30? If that’s aggressive for you, tell me which milestone to move and we’ll adjust.

Doc: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1A2b3C_acme-map-draft
Attachments: acme_map_template_v1.pdf (compact MAP), close_trajectory_spreadsheet.xlsx

Next steps I propose:
1) Maria confirms stakeholders and any blackout dates (by Thu 9/17)
2) Redwood provides a short technical kickoff agenda and test data checklist (by Mon 9/20)
3) Procurement and Legal exchange initial term sheet (pipeline to procurement team)

Thanks — I’ve copied Monica and Marissa to help surface any enablement artifacts we should include.

Best,
